summary: Stem, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for the resale of up to 289,045 shares of common stock by selling shareholder raicoon GmbH. No price or premium is stated as shares are to be sold at prevailing market prices ($8.22 as of June 18, 2026). This is a routine shelf registration resale filing, not a special situation. The company is not acquiring or selling assets, nor conducting a strategic review or returning capital. The deal terms are empty because the filing does not provide per-share price, premium, expected close, or break fees.
